description: Where each legacy site URL goes now that the Next export is the site root. First matching rule wins. Mirrored by the CloudFront viewer-request function in redact-secret-sites; validated by tests/legacy-url-redirects.test.mjs against src/model.mjs (parseRoute) and the routes of web/app.
paths: A request path without its trailing slash is matched; a `to` ends in a slash because the export serves directories. `match` is an anchored JavaScript regular expression over the path; `to` substitutes {name} from its named groups. `ID` is [a-z0-9-]+.

kept.reason: The landing page of the new site. The legacy `/` redirected to /report; it no longer does.

rules.decision: Same page, trailing slash only.
Legacy already redirected it to /report.
The legacy page served a detector or a suite depending on a list only the app knew; an edge function cannot tell which, and guessing sends half the bookmarks to a 404. The report hub links both.
The coverage page listed families by provider; /report/families/ is the family list with the same counts.
Legacy redirected it to /coverage, so it follows /coverage.
Detector pages exist under the report with the same ids.
A family id is provider:family; its page slug replaces the colon with two hyphens (familySlug in web/resolvers/families.ts).
Legacy redirected /coverage/:id to /coverage/detectors/:id.
Legacy redirected it to /coverage/detectors/:id.

No support page exists in the new site; each family page carries its recorded status and evidence, so the family list is the closest entrance. /evaluation/qualification/ shows the derived support status per population but is a different question.
The providers roadmap's successor is the provider list, which carries each provider's dossier.
Same path; the legacy /evaluation redirected to /evaluation/credentials, the new /evaluation/ is the hub of the evaluation pages.
The new route is singular.
Same page, trailing slash only.
Legacy sent both to /workbench, which is /evaluation/ now.
Legacy sent it to the mutation method.
Same path; trailing slash only. An id that is not one of the six methods is not matched and stays a 404, as it was.
The performance page is now one of the comparison pages.
There is no how-to-read page; the comparison overview is where a reader is told which question each page answers. /methodology followed /how-to-read in the legacy table.
Scenarios have no page in the new site; the report hub is the entrance to every group of fixtures.
A suite is a fixture group page; the ids are the same.
A legacy fixture slug is `<category>--<id>`; a fixture is opened on its suite page with ?fixture=<id> (fixtureHref in the web app). Split at the first `--`.
Legacy sent it to the t0-fixtures review class, which has no page; the evaluation hub is the nearest.
Evaluation replaces the Workbench.
The Changes page compared a candidate with the release; /evaluation/rc/ is that comparison.
The qualification page of the evaluation section.
The review queue has no page in the new site; the findings page lists reviewed findings but not the queue, so the hub is the honest target.
The method pages kept their ids.

retiredPrefix.decision: The preview prefix of the previous decision. Strip it and keep the query; the result is a route of the export, or the root (when rest is empty), and is then redirected again if it is a legacy path.
